subject: Eight fictional demo team members; these are synthetic portraits, not real employee photographs.
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one seamless avatar sprite atlas for a CRM's eight FICTIONAL demo team members. Bottom row from left: (5) androgynous adult in their 30s, medium brown skin, short loose dark curls, green shirt; (6) adult in their 40s, light brown skin, short dark hair, fine dark eyeglasses, gray shirt; (7) androgynous adult in their 30s, fair freckled skin, short auburn hair, navy sweater; (8) woman in her 30s, dark skin and voluminous natural curly black hair, muted plum blouse. Match face scale, camera height and lighting across all tiles. The deliverable is the single 4x2 photographic atlas for direct website use, not a mockup or a collage with margins.
